context_for_next_testing_agent: Content layer refactoring complete and verified. All editable content (text, labels, data) now lives in /src/content/*.js files: 1) site.js contains hero, company, statistics, testimonials, clients, team, values, processSteps, targetAudiences, footerNav, ctaSection. 2) projects.js contains project data with helpers (getProjectBySlug, getFeaturedProjects, getProjectsByCategory). 3) services.js contains servicePages for pillar pages (FAQs, services) and re-exports navStructure and subservices from /data/. 4) images.js provides centralized image map with null placeholders. Layout components import from content layer using named exports. The Footer previously crashed due to 'socialLinks is not defined' - fixed by using company.socialLinks. No functional regressions from refactoring.
